name: sii-4b-bench
description: Throughput/utilization sweep for SII-Decision-4B on one 8xH100 node: 8x1 replicas at batch 4/8/16 and 4x2 model-parallel replicas, 800-row stride subset each. Writes per-shard nvidia-smi profiles and an aggregate profile.json.
command:
set -uo pipefail
R=/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/DiffRwkv/decision_compare
V=$R/.venv-sii
mkdir -p $R/logs/qz $R/runs/qz
cd $R
export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1
export PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
export TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM=false
export PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True

fail=0
echo "=== b4_8x1: shards=8 gpr=1 batch=4 budget=32768 ==="
MODEL=$R/models/SII-4B-LoRA INPUT=$R/data/jeval/sii_input.jsonl \
OUTDIR=$R/runs/qz/sii_4b_bench/b4_8x1 \
SHARDS=8 GPUS_PER_REPLICA=1 BATCH_SIZE=4 MAX_BATCH_TOKENS=32768 \
LIMIT=800 LIMIT_MODE=stride SCORE=0 RESUME=0 \
bash harness/run_sii_eval.sh > $R/logs/qz/sii_4b_bench_b4_8x1.log 2>&1 || fail=1
mkdir -p $R/runs/qz/sii_4b_bench/profiles
cp -f $R/runs/qz/sii_4b_bench/b4_8x1/profile.json $R/runs/qz/sii_4b_bench/profiles/profile-0.json || true
echo "=== b8_8x1: shards=8 gpr=1 batch=8 budget=32768 ==="
MODEL=$R/models/SII-4B-LoRA INPUT=$R/data/jeval/sii_input.jsonl \
OUTDIR=$R/runs/qz/sii_4b_bench/b8_8x1 \
SHARDS=8 GPUS_PER_REPLICA=1 BATCH_SIZE=8 MAX_BATCH_TOKENS=32768 \
LIMIT=800 LIMIT_MODE=stride SCORE=0 RESUME=0 \
bash harness/run_sii_eval.sh > $R/logs/qz/sii_4b_bench_b8_8x1.log 2>&1 || fail=1
mkdir -p $R/runs/qz/sii_4b_bench/profiles
cp -f $R/runs/qz/sii_4b_bench/b8_8x1/profile.json $R/runs/qz/sii_4b_bench/profiles/profile-1.json || true
echo "=== b16_8x1: shards=8 gpr=1 batch=16 budget=65536 ==="
MODEL=$R/models/SII-4B-LoRA INPUT=$R/data/jeval/sii_input.jsonl \
OUTDIR=$R/runs/qz/sii_4b_bench/b16_8x1 \
SHARDS=8 GPUS_PER_REPLICA=1 BATCH_SIZE=16 MAX_BATCH_TOKENS=65536 \
LIMIT=800 LIMIT_MODE=stride SCORE=0 RESUME=0 \
bash harness/run_sii_eval.sh > $R/logs/qz/sii_4b_bench_b16_8x1.log 2>&1 || fail=1
mkdir -p $R/runs/qz/sii_4b_bench/profiles
cp -f $R/runs/qz/sii_4b_bench/b16_8x1/profile.json $R/runs/qz/sii_4b_bench/profiles/profile-2.json || true
echo "=== b8_4x2: shards=4 gpr=2 batch=8 budget=32768 ==="
MODEL=$R/models/SII-4B-LoRA INPUT=$R/data/jeval/sii_input.jsonl \
OUTDIR=$R/runs/qz/sii_4b_bench/b8_4x2 \
SHARDS=4 GPUS_PER_REPLICA=2 BATCH_SIZE=8 MAX_BATCH_TOKENS=32768 \
LIMIT=800 LIMIT_MODE=stride SCORE=0 RESUME=0 \
bash harness/run_sii_eval.sh > $R/logs/qz/sii_4b_bench_b8_4x2.log 2>&1 || fail=1
mkdir -p $R/runs/qz/sii_4b_bench/profiles
cp -f $R/runs/qz/sii_4b_bench/b8_4x2/profile.json $R/runs/qz/sii_4b_bench/profiles/profile-3.json || true
"$V/bin/python" -I $R/harness/sii_gpu_eval.py --merge-profiles $R/runs/qz/sii_4b_bench/profiles --output $R/runs/qz/sii_4b_bench/profile.json
cat $R/runs/qz/sii_4b_bench/profile.json > $R/logs/qz/sii_4b_bench_summary.json
[ $fail -eq 0 ] || echo "one or more benchmark configs failed"
exit $fail
